full_prompt_en: A square richly detailed oil painting shows a man in an embroidered red vest seated beside a large tawny dog on open grassland. The man sits left of center on a low rocky mound, facing slightly toward the right but looking out across the plain. A black cap covers short dark hair, and his composed face catches clear daylight. He wears a white long-sleeved shirt, a bright red vest covered in gold and floral embroidery, pale trousers, and reddish-brown boots. One hand rests near his knee, and the relaxed pose gives him a quiet presence within the broad landscape. The dog lies close against his right side, head raised and ears alert, its thick brown fur modeled in warm highlights and deeper shadow. Around them, grasses and small red flowers cover the mound and run into the middle distance. Beyond, a wide plain stretches toward low mountains beneath a blue sky filled with scattered cream clouds. Small groups of animals or figures dot the far ground and become indistinct with distance. A darker evergreen and a few sparse trees interrupt the horizon toward the right. The composition places highly worked clothing, fur, and flowers in the near foreground, then lets the open land soften into atmospheric light. Fine brush details and careful edge control give the subjects a substantial physical presence, while broad painted strokes shape clouds and distant terrain. Sunlight comes from the upper left, brightening the shirt, red vest, dog's back, and flower tops; cool shadows settle in folds and beneath the animal. No text appears. The overall composition balances a vivid human-animal pair with expansive sky and grassland, creating a poised, contemplative pastoral scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、细节丰富的油画呈现一名穿刺绣红背心的男子与一只大型浅棕狗坐在开阔草地上。男子坐在中央偏左的低矮石丘上，身体略朝右，目光却望向平原。黑帽盖住短深发，沉着面孔接住清澈日光。他穿白长袖衬衫、布满金色花纹刺绣的鲜红背心、浅色长裤与红棕靴。一只手靠在膝旁，放松姿势让他在宽阔景观中有安静的存在感。狗紧贴他右侧卧着，抬头、双耳警觉，厚棕毛由暖亮部和较深阴影塑形。周围，草和小红花铺满石丘，继续延向中景。其后，宽广平原一直伸向低山，蓝天中散布奶油色云。远方地面点缀小群动物或人物，随距离渐渐难辨。右侧一棵较深常青树和几棵稀疏树木打断地平线。构图把描绘细密的衣物、毛发和花朵放在近前景，再让开放土地柔化进大气光线。细笔触与谨慎的边缘控制赋予主体坚实实体感，宽笔则塑造云与远地。阳光从左上方来，照亮衬衫、红背心、狗背与花顶；冷影落进衣褶和动物身下。没有文字。整体构图以鲜明的人与动物组合平衡辽阔天空和草原，形成沉稳、沉思的田园场景。
style_prompt_en: Detailed oil painting places finely modeled focal surfaces within broad, luminous landscape space. Bright embroidered red and warm gold accents stand out against tawny earth, muted green, and open blue sky. Small controlled strokes articulate texture near the viewer; distant ground and clouds use wider, softer passages. Clear daylight lights exposed planes and leaves cool colored shadow in folds and under overlapping masses. The composition gives a compact warm focal group room to breathe within expansive horizontal land and sky. The result is vivid, substantial, and contemplative.
style_prompt_zh: 细致油画把精心塑形的焦点表面置于宽阔发光的景观空间里。明亮刺绣红与暖金色强调从浅棕土地、柔绿和开放蓝天前跳出。近处小型受控笔触描绘肌理，远地和云采用更宽、更柔的色块。清澈日光照亮外露平面，冷调彩色阴影留在褶皱与重叠色团下。构图让紧凑暖色焦点组在宽阔水平土地与天空中有呼吸空间。整体鲜明、厚实而沉思。
theme_en: A man in an embroidered red vest seated beside a large dog on open grassland
theme_zh: 一名穿刺绣红背心的男子与大狗坐在开阔草地上
name: Kent Monkman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
